notes: Partition verified: s001–s030 and t001–t034 each used once.

The single אֲשֶׁר takes both of the ASV's *that*s in one discontinuous unit under rule 55's coordinated-subordinator clause; the second clause stands under the one written relative, so nothing is `added`.
Both לְ + suffix possessives carry *have* on the preposition under rule 43, with the suffixes `unrepresented` because the shared relative supplies the English subject.
The chain's two *the*s are counted by which word each stands before (rule 29): the supplied one goes to תוֹךְ and the written article of מְרִי takes the *the* before its own rendering *rebellious*.
